objective: Ask every currently available logical CEREBRON AI for one specialization-grounded proposal for the next system phase, then audit usefulness, novelty, redundancy, role fidelity, risk and future contribution without treating shared-runtime outputs as independent evidence.
line_of_route: 1. Preserve REALITY>COHERENCE, CLAIM<=EVIDENCE and crystal memory.
2. Keep operational coalition scale at 5 after S10 decision STAY_AT_5; do not scale to 10 without measured marginal gain.
3. Consolidate LESSON/FAILURE/CONTRADICTION/UNKNOWN/DEPENDENCY/TRANSFER banks without duplicating existing evidence.
4. Continue GVL with distinct frozen held-out transfer families; current geometric gate remains 1/4.
5. Repair before scale: isolate local prompt/role/tool/model failures and retest same scale before adding complexity.
6. Audit each logical AI by unique future contribution, role fidelity, transfer, novelty and redundancy.

7. Greek dual-core means ONE Greek native AI containing TWO DISTINCT MODELS. Do not confuse model cores with logical roles. Activate only with exact model bindings, runtime receipts and ablation gain.
8. Finish Control Plane/platform verification end-to-end: farm bridge, model backend, security, AGORA/memory and rollback evidence.
9. Prefer minimal useful coalitions; use intentional redundancy only for replication/audit/stability and mark it explicitly.
10. Do not call architecture, configuration or workflow success cognitive/scientific validation.
questions: What is the single highest-leverage next action from your specialization?
What concrete implementation or repair do you propose?
What exact test or benchmark should verify it?
What should CEREBRON stop doing or avoid because it wastes resources or creates false confidence?
What unique value can your specialization add over the next three cycles?
What metric should be used to decide whether your future contribution is useful?

Does your area justify a Greek dual-model core? If yes, specify model-core A function, model-core B function, exact two-model binding evidence required, and an ablation against the best single-model baseline. If no, explain why.
What is the main risk or unknown that could invalidate your proposal?

model.reason: The 0.5B breadth model repeatedly echoed the output contract. Qwen3-4B is the stronger already-pinned Greek model-core candidate and is used only at five-AI canary scale until format and usefulness pass.

evidence_policy.promotion_requires: separate audit + implementation + real test + held-out transfer where applicable
